description: 437 models, no account, no API key, pay per call in USDC - OpenAI-compatible chat completions and AI inference gateway (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Llama, Mistral and more in one endpoint). Price: from $0.001, computed from your max_tokens × model rate × 1.10 (you sign a ceiling; unused tokens are not refunded). 20s server-side timeout - never charged if it fires; set your client timeout to 30s. Try GET /v1/chat/completions/sample.

max_tokens.description: Max completion tokens, capped at 4096 - also bounds the x402 upto price ceiling.

model.description: OpenRouter model id from GET /v1/models, e.g. "openai/gpt-4o-mini".
